title: Preserve project hooks and repair standalone feature state
goal: Upgrade or adopt Throughline without deleting project-owned commit checks or leaving portable feature state stranded under an agent-specific directory.
in_scope: Install the live Throughline pre-commit hook only when no live hook exists
Refresh a live hook only when it can be identified as Throughline-managed
Leave unrelated custom hooks byte-for-byte unchanged and report manual composition as required
Include feature-* directories in report, apply, and conflict behavior for --repair-state across every unsupported platform root
out_of_scope: Executing or rewriting arbitrary third-party hook managers
Forcing state conflicts or overwriting existing .throughline destinations
acceptance: sync-plugin.mjs --apply installs the Throughline pre-commit hook only when no live hook exists or the live hook is already Throughline-managed; an unrelated custom hook remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is reported for manual composition, while --repair-state detects, reports, moves, and conflict-protects feature-* working directories under every unsupported platform root just as it does epic-* and ship-* state.
invariants: Project-owned hooks are never overwritten without explicit force or manual action
Portable working state has exactly one authoritative destination under .throughline
Repair remains report-only unless --apply is present
